conditions.headline: SW energy peaks through the AM session under E/ENE winds. SE winds trend through PM
conditions.observation: Trailing bump of SW swell to see size peak through the morning with some decent energy behind it to see 2ft OH+ surf for the southern exposures and magnets. Keep in mind the drained-out 0.3 m low tide at dawn that will limit options, but with the incoming tide, expect some fun/good waves through the mid-morning period. SE winds will trend through the PM session, making for a nice afternoon of Bukit reef waves with the dropping tide

conditions.headline: Slowly fading swell from the SW. User friendly, good surf expected.
conditions.observation: The latest run of SW swell is expected to lose energy today. Still, for the exposures, size should be in the overhead+ range and quite appealing. Early E/ENE winds will favour the west coast breaks that work with a low tide. A late morning SE wind swing will then make for the best and most appealing conditions seen down along the Bukit peninsula.

conditions.headline: Early signs of fresh long period SSW swell later in the day, south swell magnets to grow in size
conditions.observation: Worth watching the south swell magnets through the day. These will lift from the initial mid sized, relatively mellow morning surf to a little bit more of an energetic 2ft OH, occasionally bigger in the afternoon. Selective swell angle means less exposed spots will see much less of this wrapping in. Decent potential on the Bukit reefs, with afternoon wind something to watch for the outer corners.
